destination.publisher_rules: PENDING VERIFICATION against the live C&S Guide for Authors; screened only against the skill's dated Elsevier snapshot

outputs.format: PDF (vector, Type 42 / CID TrueType Arial, opaque white, RGB)

transformations: analysis/analyze.py -> analysis/outputs/stats.json (Wilson CIs, Newcombe paired differences, exact McNemar test; gate audit; exclusive store classes; the race per load)
figures/v7/scripts/derive_numbers.py -> figures/v7/derived_numbers.json (exclusive classes of the stores still sending; per-sandbox race lags, medians and out-of-axis counts)
fig5/scripts/derive_fig5_numbers.py -> fig5/derived_numbers.json (per-load race lags for the raster, asserted against stats.json)

fig5/scripts/make_fig5_panels.py (drawing only; the panels print no number besides axis ticks; every drawn value registered as a mark in panels/fig5_numbers.csv, the ticks in panels/fig5_ticks.csv; checked by scripts/trace_fig5.py)
fig5/scripts/make_caption_fig5.py (the caption and alt text carry every count; registry panels/caption_fig5_numbers.csv)
uncertainty: a: Wilson 95% CIs of a share (stores are the unit; the three arms are the same 231 stores), drawn as vertical lines in the colour of their mark; paired differences in the caption: Newcombe hybrid-score 95% CIs and an exact McNemar test. b: the Wilson 95% CI of each bar total (stores still sending), drawn by figstyle.bar_ci as a horizontal line; the class segments are complete counts. c: complete counts (no interval). No bootstrap (no seed needed).
missing_data: b: 1 GPC store matched no class and is not drawn (stated in the caption; it is inside the CI's total); what the gate held is stated in the caption, not drawn. c: none (every sandbox lies inside the symmetric-log axis, asserted).
note: No automated report here certifies accessibility or journal compliance (skill guardrail).
